ЗАДАЧА 3 — feat: GAP 5 evidently drift monitoring cron
  scripts/run-drift-monitor.sh — 6h drift analysis on corpus JSONL
    composite_drift = avg_drift×0.4 + refuted_rate×0.4 + flag_rate×0.2
    Telegram alert if composite > 0.15
    Evidently AI if available, else heuristic
  scripts/deploy-gap5-drift-monitor.sh — deploys cron 0 */6 * * * on GMKtec

docs/MEMORY.md: architecture constraints, privilege model, deferred projects,
